Inside WindowsDebugUiHost::renderFrame, invoke DebugController::buildImGuiFrame after ImGui::NewFrame and before ImGui::Render. Preserve the current same-dispatch second redraw when the controller reports a submitted control, but the second frame must also come only from DebugController.

In Windows main, keep concrete RuntimeFacade/diagnostics/debug-control provider ownership but replace platform-local DebugSnapshotAssembler/DebugActivityLog/DebugControlRouter/debug snapshot-channel composition with one DebugController constructed from DebugControllerContext. Route the Windows temporary native toolbar through RuntimeFacade product controls. Map Vector/Marker/Chalk/Membrane to setBrush, Object/Partial Eraser to setEraser, and Selection to setSelectionMode. Use nonzero monotonic product request IDs and current Runtime generation readback. Do not call Host product mutation methods directly from the toolbar adapter. Separate the concrete RuntimeFacade Host-application helper from the toolbar adapter so RuntimeFacade never recursively calls selectWindowsTool.
Preserve Windows temporary toolbar presentation and G4.7 text qualification menu/action behavior; do not migrate text qualification actions into RuntimeFacade.
Update Web structural oracle first so the old captureDebugSnapshot/buildImGuiPanels/local router path fails.

Refactor Web DebugUiState to own/use one DebugController and remove local DebugSnapshotAssembler/DebugActivityLog/DebugControlRouter/selected-tool panel construction state. Keep WebGL debug surface, ImGui context, input mapping, visibility and resize ownership unchanged.

Make the Web RuntimeFacade adapter lifecycle independent of Debug UI visibility and use the same product adapter for both temporary exported toolbar functions and DebugController context. Existing exports axiom_ink_select_brush_profile and axiom_ink_select_tool remain source-compatible where practical but must route through RuntimeFacade product controls rather than direct Host::selectBrushProfile/selectTool mutation.

In Web renderDebugUi, invoke DebugController::buildImGuiFrame between ImGui::NewFrame and ImGui::Render; retain one same-dispatch second common-controller frame after a submitted product control so resolved readback is visible.

Modify Web index.html only if required to preserve existing toolbar/debug-canvas sizing/input behavior or the existing product bridge call sequence; do not remove toolPalette/brushBar or text qualification UI.

Update Windows common/selection/encoding and Web structural tests to prove controller convergence, RuntimeFacade toolbar routing and preserved input/lifecycle boundaries without weakening existing assertions.
Run focused PX0/DUI regressions, fresh Windows native build, Web physical target build, structural contracts, scope audit and git diff --check.
